loop_order: first K frozen Robot1 query-arrival rows with pre-existing Robot3 database; separate recordings, NOT simultaneous causal two-stream time
initialization: same frozen Stage12D first-arrival common trajectory for every independent solve and repetition; no warm start

graph_policy.node_ids: original (robot_id,keyframe_id), preserved in GTSAM symbols and exported CSVs
graph_policy.local_coordinate_gauge: exact Stage10.3 KF0-relative local matrices; retained values are not rebased or repaired
graph_policy.graph_anchor: Robot1 KF150 at its frozen local Pose3
graph_policy.odometry_source: raw ekf/odometry_map, nearest frozen LiDAR timestamps; T_world_imu @ T_imu_lidar; same Stage10.3 helper
graph_policy.odometry_factor: Z_i,i+1 = X_i^-1 X_i+1, only sequential retained IDs
graph_policy.loop_filter: query robot1 KF>=150 AND candidate robot3 KF>=234; no other filtering
graph_policy.default_initialization: FIRST_ARRIVAL_INIT; accepted only when frozen equivalence diagnostics pass
graph_policy.arrival_order: query_timestamp, query_keyframe_id, candidate_keyframe_id; separate-run R1->R3 replay query order
graph_policy.optimizer: GTSAM 4.2 Pose3 LevenbergMarquardtOptimizer, unchanged documented default parameters

catastrophic_integrity_rule.new_lineage_jump: post XYZ>5x Stage12C frozen XY step limit AND pre-common XYZ<=5x same limit

solver_policy.parameter_text:
relative decrease threshold: 1e-05
absolute decrease threshold: 1e-05
      total error threshold: 0
         maximum iterations: 100
                  verbosity: SILENT
         linear solver type: MULTIFRONTAL CHOLESKY
                   ordering: COLAMD
              lambdaInitial: 1e-05
               lambdaFactor: 10
           lambdaUpperBound: 100000
           lambdaLowerBound: 0
           minModelFidelity: 0.001
            diagonalDamping: 0
                minDiagonal: 1e-06
                maxDiagonal: 1e+32
                verbosityLM: SILENT

metric: union of two directed 3D nearest-neighbor distance arrays between separately voxelized source maps
residual: Stage12D E=Z^-1 Xq^-1 Xc; physical translation norm, rotation angle; reconstructed diagnostic Huber weight not internal GTSAM weight

benchmark.p95: small-sample empirical percentile, not reliable latency-tail estimate
benchmark.graph_construction: reuse exact Stage12D factor template; per-K prefix-copy cost, template build reported separately
benchmark.total: prefix construction + one canonical measured solve + map construction/export + global/ROI consistency; excludes warmup/repeats and GT

reproduction_tolerances.reason: same deterministic factors/solver/scans; float64 CSV round-trip tolerance fixed before new runs

sparse_rule.primary: smallest K<75 with global NN median and p95 <=1.10 times K75, normal finite solve, no new catastrophic steps
sparse_rule.secondary: same ROI comparison; not used for primary selection

GT_policy: all solves, repetitions and GT-free metrics precede persisted decision; only then read GT; no solve after GT
